record.summary: Poland's law implementing the EU AI Act. It makes the Commission for the Development and Security of Artificial Intelligence (KRiBSI) the market surveillance authority and single point of contact: a chair, two deputies and four members nominated by the competition and consumer, financial, broadcasting and electronic communications regulators. The Commission handles complaints, can order an AI system withdrawn from the market or from use when it poses a direct risk to life, health, safety or fundamental rights, runs regulatory sandboxes, issues individual opinions and imposes administrative fines.
record.notes: Dated 3 July 2026 and published in the Dziennik Ustaw on 27 July 2026 (item 1003), signed by President K. Nawrocki. Article 127 sets entry into force 14 days after publication, on 11 August 2026, with Article 125(4) from 28 July 2026 and Articles 8-18 and Chapters 3-5, 8 and 9 (including the Commission's procedures and penalties) three months after publication, on 28 October 2026. The Ministry of Digital Affairs is to set up the Commission and its chair within two months of entry into force (Article 125(4)). The act also amends ten other acts, among them the Code of Civil Procedure and the laws on radio and television, on the Internal Security Agency and on the national cybersecurity system.
